title: Successful login
steps: Enter valid username and password ; Click Login
expected_result: Products page opens and its title is Products

title: Invalid password - wrong value
steps: Enter valid username and wrong password ; Click Login
expected_result: Invalid-credentials error appears and user remains on Login page

title: Invalid password - wrong case
steps: Enter valid username and wrong-case password ; Click Login
expected_result: Invalid-credentials error appears and user remains on Login page

title: Invalid password - trailing space
steps: Enter valid username and password with trailing space ; Click Login
expected_result: Invalid-credentials error appears and user remains on Login page

title: Invalid password - spaces only
steps: Enter valid username and spaces-only password ; Click Login
expected_result: Invalid-credentials error appears and user remains on Login page

title: Blank password
steps: Enter valid username and empty password ; Click Login
expected_result: Error contains Password is required and user remains on Login page

title: Add one item (cart size 0 -> 1)
preconditions: Logged in as standard_user; on Products; cart empty
test_data: Sauce Labs Backpack (EP: any product is one class; Sauce Labs Bike Light = untouched control)
steps: Check badge is empty ; Click Add to cart on Sauce Labs Backpack
expected_result: Badge 0 to 1; Backpack button changes to Remove; Bike Light button stays Add to cart

title: Add a second item (cart size 1 -> 2)
preconditions: Logged in as standard_user; on Products; cart empty
test_data: Sauce Labs Backpack, Sauce Labs Bike Light
steps: Click Add to cart on Sauce Labs Backpack ; Click Add to cart on Sauce Labs Bike Light
expected_result: Badge 1 after first item, 2 after second; both buttons show Remove

title: Add every product (cart size 5 -> 6, upper boundary)
preconditions: Logged in as standard_user; on Products; cart empty
steps: Click Add to cart on each product in turn, top to bottom
expected_result: Badge increments by 1 after each click (1..6); each clicked button changes to Remove

title: Cart shows the same names and prices as Products (2 items)
preconditions: Logged in as standard_user; on Products; cart empty
test_data: Sauce Labs Backpack, Sauce Labs Bike Light
steps: Note name and price of both items on Products ; Click Add to cart on both ; Open the cart
expected_result: Your Cart opens and lists exactly the 2 items with the same names and prices as on Products

title: Cart shows the same names and prices as Products (all 6 items, upper boundary)
preconditions: Logged in as standard_user; on Products; cart empty
steps: Note name and price of every product on Products ; Click Add to cart on each ; Open the cart
expected_result: Your Cart opens and lists exactly 6 items with the same names and prices as on Products

title: Checkout from the cart opens Your Information
preconditions: Logged in as standard_user; on Products; cart empty
steps: Click Add to cart on Sauce Labs Backpack ; Open the cart ; Click Checkout

title: Mandatory First Name validation
preconditions: Logged in with Sauce Labs Backpack in cart; on Checkout: Your Information
test_data: First Name blank; Last Name User; Postal Code 12345
steps: Leave First Name blank and enter valid last name and postal code ; Click Continue
expected_result: Error contains 'First Name is required'; remain on Checkout: Your Information

title: Four digit postal code is invalid

expected_result: Validation error displayed; remain on Checkout: Your Information

title: Five digit postal code is valid
preconditions: Logged in with Sauce Labs Backpack in cart; on Checkout: Your Information

title: Six digit postal code is valid
preconditions: Logged in with Sauce Labs Backpack in cart; on Checkout: Your Information

title: Alphabetic postal code is invalid
preconditions: Logged in with Sauce Labs Backpack in cart; on Checkout: Your Information
expected_result: Validation error displayed; remain on Checkout: Your Information

title: Mixed alphanumeric postal code is invalid
preconditions: Logged in with Sauce Labs Backpack in cart; on Checkout: Your Information
expected_result: Validation error displayed; remain on Checkout: Your Information

title: Complete an order with valid information
preconditions: Logged in as standard_user; Sauce Labs Backpack in cart; on Checkout: Your Information
test_data: First name Test, last name User, postal code 12345
steps: Fill in valid information ; Click Continue ; Click Finish
expected_result: Checkout: Complete! shows "Thank you for your order!"; cart badge is gone
